source_review.notes: Checked current NASA Decision Analysis, Design Solution Definition, and Technical Assessment pages; official NASA-HDBK-7009A; the official NASA RIDM record; official GAO representations for GAO-20-195G and GAO-16-89G; NIST Technical Note 1297 and the NIST/SEMATECH propagation guidance; and the official European Commission JRC record for Saltelli, Tarantola, and Chan. NASA web/standards, NIST, and JRC resources returned HTTP 200. The NASA NTRS record timed out and GAO pages returned HTTP 403 to the command-line client after their official representations had been inspected through the web retrieval path. The chapter distinguishes local coefficients, uncertainty contribution, global variance attribution, threshold sensitivity, decision robustness, and model credibility in accordance with the sources' bounded uses.
